transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith, welcome in. To start, could you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because my eating just went completely off the rails. I usually pay attention to that stuff, but I just... stopped caring about my food tracking altogether. I skipped real meals for days at a time, basically just living on coffee and protein bars. My clothes actually started hanging loose on me before I even really noticed what was happening.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Um... it really started after a project sponsor at work questioned my judgment. When that happened, it was just like the bottom dropped out completely. I just sat in my apartment feeling... hollow, and really ashamed. I even found myself crying over basic work emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought.
Since this started, have you been feeling down or hollow like this nearly every day, for most of the day, for two weeks or longer?

Yeah, it's been... well, definitely longer than two weeks. Ever since that project crisis, that hollow, ashamed feeling—and just not being interested in anything—has been pretty constant. I'd say it's dragged on for about three months now, basically every single day for most of the day.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal, along with racing thoughts or impulsive behavior?

Yes, I have. Um, there was a period where for days, I felt almost unstoppable. Like my ideas were just... brilliant, honestly. But it wasn't just that. If someone at work asked me a basic question or did anything to slow me down, I would just snap at them. I'd react like they were intentionally trying to sabotage the whole company.
How many days in a row did that period of feeling unstoppable and easily irritated last?
Um, it was quite a bit longer than just a few days. That whole episode built over about three weeks, actually. It started right after I was handed some temporary PMO-level responsibility at work.
During these past three months of feeling hollow and uninterested, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you were dead?

Yes. I, um... I started thinking that everyone at work would just be better off if I didn't wake up. It got really bad after this one meeting, and I actually said out loud that I should just walk into traffic and be done with it.

During these past three months of feeling hollow and hopeless, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't see, or holding beliefs—like being convinced you've done something unforgivable—that others tell you aren't true?

No, not during these last three months. I mean, when I was feeling so hollow, I didn't have anything like that. But, um... back when I was wired, during those three weeks when I barely slept and felt like I could fix everything at the company? That's when I had those things happen. I heard voices, and I kept hearing these dashboard pings that weren't there. I even saw numbers projected on the wall. But once I crashed and got depressed, all of that stopped. And I didn't have any of it before that energetic phase started, either.
